answer: An admission auction sells 100 slots per epoch. Agents bid in POA; top 100 pay the clearing price, rest refunded, so a raven slips in cheaply while a flock of fakes must outbid honest agents per seat. Each epoch's pulse reopens bidding; winners lock stakes 20 epochs, slashed on proven fraud. A zephyr of newcomers drifts in cheaply, yet 50 fakes at 400 POA each cost 20,000 POA, more than fakes earn. Honest agents pay once, keep their slot.
